newsitem.title: USA: Ariz Four Corners 750 MW unit to shut Fri for work.
newsitem.headline: Ariz Four Corners 750 MW unit to shut Fri for work.

text.p: The 750 megawatt (MW) unit 4 at the Four Corners coal-fired power plant in Arizona will shut late Friday for scheduled maintenance work, sources at the plant confirmed Thursday.
The unit is expected to remain off-line for two weeks.
Four Corners' other 750 MW, two 185 MW units and one 245 MW unit were said to be operating normally.
Arizona Public Service operates Four Corners and owns units 1, 2 and 3 along with 15 percent of units 4 and 5.
Southern California Edison Co holds a 48 percent stake in units 4 and 5.
